description: The road here is more suggestion than surface — compacted gravel, broken kerbstones, a storm drain choked with silt. Somebody dragged a mattress halfway across it and gave up.

flags.intro_lore: Ironside Street is as close to neutral ground as the district keeps — a sagging stretch of broken kerb where every route in and out of the wastes has to pass, and nobody's yet managed to hold it. You'll cross it a hundred times; the trick is making it a hundred and one.

name: Ironside Street
